text:
Clara: Postmortem posted for the tail-latency cluster events during high-traffic window. Need action owners for SLO follow-ups.
Theo: read it. symptom summary?
Clara: p95 steady ~200ms, p99 spikes up to 1.4s during two peak intervals. error-budget burn concentrated on Tue/Thu evenings.
Rina: proposal: do NOT change customer-facing p99 yet. Add a transient "burst" SLI (p999 over 5m) to capture spikes and create mitigation path.
Theo: agree. also add a routing guard: when avg queue_ms > 250 AND inflight_per_gpu > 30 -> route to quantized fallback.
Owen: I'll take dashboards. Will add panels: p95, p99, p999-burst(5m), burn-rate by weekday, queue-depth heatmap, and incident annotations.
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget_burn=0.38 over 24h; spikes Tue 17:10-18:05, Thu 16:50-18:20.
Clara: action list: 1) Define burst SLI + dashboards (owner: Owen) due 2026-04-27. 2) Implement routing guard + throttle (owner: Theo) due 2026-04-23. 3) Canary test plan for batching/kv-cache thresholds (owner: Rina) due 2026-05-06. 4) Follow-up doc with SLO acceptance/rollback criteria (owner: Clara) due 2026-04-29.
Theo: I'll add config snippet in PR: ```yaml
serving:
  fallback: quantized
  guard:
    queue_ms_threshold: 250
    max_inflight_per_gpu: 30
```
Rina: Canary plan: synthetic 3x peak for 48h, collect kv-cache hit, latencies, and error-budget burn.
Owen: dashboard PR by EOD Friday, will annotate incidents.
Clara: we monitor for two weeks after deploy before any SLO roll. I'll create the tracker and ping daily.
Theo: opening PR today and tagging @ops for review.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance 2026-04-25 03:00-04:00 UTC.
Clara: thanks all, will update incident timeline and brief SRE sync. :thumbsup:
